name: Grimlock
sourceDistinctions: The Underdark player traits include −2 Wisdom and automatic Common and Undercommon. The core Grimlock player list has a different ability and language list.
Loss of either hearing or smell suppresses blindsight but leaves the benefit of Blind-Fight. Loss of both leaves the Grimlock effectively blinded.
The source description specifies that Grimlocks have neither eyes nor eye sockets. There is no usable darkvision for an eyeless Grimlock.
Wizards’ collected archive has no Underdark errata file. The official FAQ mentions Grimlocks in a polymorph equipment example and gives no Grimlock rules correction.
portraitForm: Diamond Hand, an original Grimlock Barbarian
